messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: DIR, Annex I, 2.3

2.3. MACHINERY FOR WORKING WOOD AND MATERIAL WITH SIMILAR PHYSICAL CHARACTERISTICS Machinery for working wood and materials with similar physical characteristics must comply with the following requirements: (a) the machinery must be designed, constructed or equipped in such a way that the piece being machined can be placed and guided in safety; where the piece is hand-held on a work-bench, the latter must be sufficiently stable during the work and must not impede the movement of the piece; (b) where the machinery is likely to be used in conditions involving the risk of ejection of workpieces or parts of them, it must be designed, constructed, or equipped in such a way as to prevent such ejection, or, if this is not possible, so that the ejection does not engender risks for the operator and/or exposed persons; (c) the machinery must be equipped with an automatic brake that stops the tool in a sufficiently short time if there is a risk of contact with the tool whilst it runs down; (d) where the tool is incorporated into a non-fully automated machine, the latter must be designed and constructed in such a way as to eliminate or reduce the risk of accidental injury.

response.text:
Machinery for working wood and materials with similar physical characteristics | mustComply | the following requirements in points (a) to (d) | "" | "must comply with the following requirements"
Machinery | mustBeDesignedSoThat | the piece being machined can be placed and guided in safety | "" | "the machinery must be designed, constructed or equipped in such a way that the piece being machined can be placed and guided in safety"
Work-bench for hand-held piece | mustBe | sufficiently stable during the work | where the piece is hand-held on a work-bench | "the latter must be sufficiently stable during the work"
Work-bench for hand-held piece | mustNotImpede | the movement of the piece | where the piece is hand-held on a work-bench | "must not impede the movement of the piece"
Machinery | mustPreventEjection | such ejection of workpieces or parts of them | where machinery is likely to be used in conditions involving risk of ejection and prevention is possible | "it must be designed, constructed, or equipped in such a way as to prevent such ejection"
Ejection | mustNotEngenderRisksFor | the operator and/or exposed persons | where prevention of ejection is not possible | "if this is not possible, so that the ejection does not engender risks for the operator and/or exposed persons"
Machinery | mustBeEquippedWith | an automatic brake that stops the tool in a sufficiently short time | if there is a risk of contact with the tool whilst it runs down | "must be equipped with an automatic brake that stops the tool in a sufficiently short time if there is a risk of contact with the tool whilst it runs down"
Non-fully automated machine with incorporated tool | mustBeDesignedToEliminateOrReduce | the risk of accidental injury | where the tool is incorporated into a non-fully automated machine | "the latter must be designed and constructed in such a way as to eliminate or reduce the risk of accidental injury"
